statement: Ivan Petrov asked Nadia Haddad for read access to the test environment for two people, Ivan Petrov and Ruth Oyelaran, for the bakery build.
value: read access to test, two users (Ivan Petrov, Ruth Oyelaran)

statement: Ivan Petrov asked whether Nadia Haddad could set up the test environment access or whether it went through Acme.
Nadia Haddad stated that test environment access went through Priya Nair because it was Acme's environment.
Nadia Haddad asked Priya Nair whether Meridian could have read access to the test environment for two users.
value: read access to test, two users

statement: Priya Nair agreed that Meridian could have read access to the test environment.
value: read access to test approved in principle
responds_to: Nadia Haddad's request on 2026-02-24 for Meridian to have read access to test for two users

statement: Priya Nair ruled out Meridian access to production and to the fresh configuration, which she said was not theirs to look at.
fact_key: Meridian production and fresh configuration access
value: no production access; no access to fresh configuration
responds_to: Nadia Haddad's request on 2026-02-24 for Meridian read access, insofar as it would cover production or the fresh configuration

statement: Priya Nair asked whether the test environment could restrict access by category, because read access to everything in test would be a different conversation.
Nadia Haddad stated that read access was read access and there was no category-level restriction in the current test environment configuration.
Nadia Haddad laid out three options: Meridian sees the fresh configuration, a separate environment is created, or Meridian works from extracts prepared by the project.
value: see fresh configuration, separate environment, or prepared extracts

statement: Nadia Haddad asked Tomas Lindholm whether a separate environment for Meridian was realistic.
Tomas Lindholm stated that a separate environment was realistic but not free, requiring roughly two weeks of setup and somewhere to run.
value: realistic but not free; roughly two weeks setup; needs hosting

statement: Tomas Lindholm recommended extracts as the cheaper option, slower for Meridian but with no risk on the fresh side.
value: extracts recommended (cheaper, slower, no fresh-side risk)

statement: Priya Nair decided that Meridian would work from extracts, stating that slower was acceptable and full read access was not.
value: extracts only; no read access to test

statement: Priya Nair stated that the reason for choosing extracts was that she could not explain to her data protection officer why a third party had read access to everything.
value: data protection: third party read access to everything not justifiable

statement: Ivan Petrov accepted the decision that Meridian would work from extracts, calling it the right call.
responds_to: Priya Nair's decision on 2026-03-02 that Meridian works from extracts rather than read access to test

statement: Ivan Petrov stated that Meridian worked from extracts on most engagements for the same data protection reason.
